exakt.Baustein 01 · Steigung & Änderungsrate: Building block 01 · Slope & rate of change
exakt.Die Gerade ist der Ursprung der gesamten: The line is the origin of all of calculus. Everything that comes later – derivative, tangent, monotonicity – is an attempt to treat curved functions locally like lines.
exakt.Wer die Steigung nicht als Änderungsrate: If you don't understand slope as a rate of change, you won't understand the derivative either.
exakt.f(x) = m·x + b — m ist die Änderung von: f(x) = m·x + b — m is the change in y per step in x, b is the function value at x = 0
exakt.Steigung aus zwei Punkten: m = Δy / Δx —: Slope from two points: m = Δy / Δx — this is already the difference quotient
exakt.Parallel: m₁ = m₂ — Orthogonal: m₁ · m₂: Parallel: m₁ = m₂ — Perpendicular: m₁ · m₂ = −1
exakt.Typischer Fehler: m berechnet, aber b ve: Typical mistake: m calculated, but b forgotten. A single point alone doesn't determine a line.
exakt.1.1 — Bestimme die Gleichung der Geraden: 1.1 — Find the equation of the line through P(−2 | 5) and Q(4 | −7).
m = (−7 − 5) / (4 − (−2)) = −12/6 = −2. Then substitute P: 5 = −2·(−2) + b = 4 + b, so b = 1. The second step is the one most often forgotten.
exakt.1.2 — Gegeben ist g: y = ¾x − 3. Wo lieg: 1.2 — Given g: y = ¾x − 3. Where is the zero?
exakt.¾x − 3 = 0 ⇒ ¾x = 3 ⇒ x = 4. Wer x = −4: ¾x − 3 = 0 ⇒ ¾x = 3 ⇒ x = 4. If you chose x = −4, you carried the sign along while rearranging instead of resolving it.
exakt.1.5 — Wie lautet die Parallele zu g: y =: 1.5 — What is the line parallel to g: y = ¾x − 3 through R(8 | 1)?
exakt.Parallel heißt gleiche Steigung, also m: Parallel means the same slope, so m = ¾. Substitute: 1 = ¾·8 + b = 6 + b ⇒ b = −5.
exakt.1.6 — Und die Senkrechte zu g durch dens: 1.6 — And the line perpendicular to g through the same point R(8 | 1)?
exakt.Orthogonalität verlangt m₁·m₂ = −1, also: Perpendicularity requires m₁·m₂ = −1, so m₂ = −4/3. Substitute: 1 = −4/3·8 + b = −32/3 + b ⇒ b = 35/3. The most common mistake is flipping only the sign and forgetting the reciprocal.
exakt.1.9 — Zwei Geraden schneiden sich nie un: 1.9 — Two lines never intersect and are not identical. What follows?
exakt.Setzt man gleich: m₁x + b₁ = m₂x + b₂. B: Set them equal: m₁x + b₁ = m₂x + b₂. With different slopes there is always exactly one solution. There is no intersection only if the x-terms cancel and a contradiction b₁ = b₂ remains.
exakt.1.10 — Die mittlere Steigung von f(x) =: 1.10 — The average slope of f(x) = x² between x₁ = 1 and x₂ = 3 is 4. Why is this not the slope of the function at a single point?
exakt.Weil 4 nur der gerundete Wert ist: Because 4 is only a rounded value
exakt.Weil sie die Steigung der Sekante durch: Because it describes the slope of the secant through two points, not the steepness at one point
exakt.Weil man dafür die zweite Ableitung brau: Because you need the second derivative for that
exakt.Die 4 ist die Steigung der Verbindungsge: The 4 is the slope of the line connecting (1|1) and (3|9). It averages over the whole interval. On the next page, exactly this quantity gives rise to the concept of the derivative, by letting the second point move closer.
exakt.Baustein 02 · Der Ableitungsbegriff: Building block 02 · The concept of the derivative
exakt.Die zentrale Idee der Analysis in einem: The central idea of calculus in one sentence: replace the slope between two points with the slope at one point by letting the second point move infinitely close.
exakt.Mittlere Änderungsrate auf [a; b]: (f(b): Average rate of change on [a; b]: (f(b) − f(a)) / (b − a) — secant slope
exakt.Lokale Änderungsrate: f′(x₀) = lim h→0 v: Instantaneous rate of change: f′(x₀) = lim h→0 of (f(x₀+h) − f(x₀)) / h
exakt.h-Methode: ausmultiplizieren, zusammenfa: h-method: expand, simplify, factor out h and cancel — only then h → 0
exakt.Drei Deutungen von f′(x₀): Tangentenstei: Three interpretations of f′(x₀): tangent slope, instantaneous velocity, growth per unit
exakt.2.1 — Die mittleren Änderungsraten von f: 2.1 — The average rates of change of f(x) = x² are 4 on [1; 3], 3 on [1; 2], and 2.1 on [1; 1.1]. What do you notice?
exakt.Die Werte fallen gegen 2, also gegen f′(: The values decrease towards 2, i.e. towards f′(1)
exakt.Die Werte nähern sich der Intervalllänge: The values approach the interval length
exakt.Je kürzer das Intervall, desto näher lie: The shorter the interval, the closer the secant slope gets to the tangent slope. The limit 2 is exactly f′(1). This is the concept of the derivative, made visible numerically.
exakt.2.2 — Der Differenzenquotient von f(x) =: 2.2 — The difference quotient of f(x) = x² on [1; 1+h] simplifies to …
exakt.((1+h)² − 1)/h = (1 + 2h + h² − 1)/h = (: ((1+h)² − 1)/h = (1 + 2h + h² − 1)/h = (2h + h²)/h = 2 + h. Only after cancelling may you let h → 0, which gives f′(1) = 2.
exakt.2.6 — Warum darf man h nicht von Anfang: 2.6 — Why can't you set h equal to 0 right from the start?
exakt.Weil dann die Funktion undefiniert wird: Because the function would then be undefined
exakt.Weil im Nenner 0 stünde und 0/0 kein Erg: Because the denominator would be 0 and 0/0 is not a result
exakt.Weil der Grenzwert sonst zu groß wird: Because the limit would otherwise be too large
exakt.Weil man erst die Ableitungsregeln brauc: Because you need the derivative rules first
exakt.Vor dem Kürzen steht 0/0 da — ein undefi: Before cancelling you have 0/0 — an undefined expression, not a number. Only factoring out and cancelling h makes the term evaluable at h = 0 at all.
f′(x) = 2x − 4, so f′(3) = 6 − 4 = 2. The h-method gives exactly the same result — that is precisely the check the workbook asks for.
exakt.2.5 — Ein Körper legt s(t) = 0,5t² zurüc: 2.5 — A body travels s(t) = 0.5t² (m, s). What is its instantaneous velocity at t = 5?
exakt.s′(t) = t, also s′(5) = 5 m/s. Die 3,5 m: s′(t) = t, so s′(5) = 5 m/s. The 3.5 m/s would be the average velocity on [2; 5] — keeping these two concepts cleanly apart is the core of this building block.
exakt.2.7 — An welcher Stelle hat f(x) = x² di: 2.7 — At which point does f(x) = x² have slope 6?
exakt.f′(x) = 2x = 6 ⇒ x = 3. Steigung 0 liegt: f′(x) = 2x = 6 ⇒ x = 3. Correspondingly, slope 0 occurs at x = 0, the vertex.
exakt.Ab hier wird nicht mehr verstanden, sond: From here on, it's not about understanding anymore, but about training. Differentiating has to be as automatic as your times tables.
exakt.Sonst verbraucht die Kurvendiskussion sp: Otherwise curve sketching will later use up all your thinking capacity in the wrong place.
exakt.Potenzregel: xⁿ ⇒ n·xⁿ⁻¹ — gilt für alle: Power rule: xⁿ ⇒ n·xⁿ⁻¹ — holds for all real exponents
exakt.Quotientenregel: (u/v)′ = (u′v − uv′) /: Quotient rule: (u/v)′ = (u′v − uv′) / v² — mind the order in the numerator
exakt.Kettenregel: äußere mal innere Ableitung: Chain rule: outer times inner derivative
exakt.Gliedweise: 20x³, −6x, +7, und die Konst: Term by term: 20x³, −6x, +7, and the constant −2 drops out. The derivative of a constant is 0, not the constant itself — one of the three fatal differentiation mistakes from the workbook.
exakt.Erst umschreiben: 4/x = 4x⁻¹. Dann Poten: Rewrite first: 4/x = 4x⁻¹. Then the power rule: 4·(−1)·x⁻² = −4x⁻². If you rewrite, you don't need the quotient rule here at all.
exakt.Äußere Ableitung 5(2x−1)⁴, innere Ableit: Outer derivative 5(2x−1)⁴, inner derivative 2, their product: 10(2x−1)⁴. Forgetting the inner derivative is the classic chain rule mistake.
exakt.Quotientenregel: (1·(x−1) − (x+1)·1)/(x−: Quotient rule: (1·(x−1) − (x+1)·1)/(x−1)² = (x − 1 − x − 1)/(x−1)² = −2/(x−1)². If you swap the order in the numerator, the sign flips — that's why the workbook states the order explicitly.
exakt.3.5 — Ein Schüler schreibt: „(x² · x³)′: 3.5 — A student writes: “(x² · x³)′ = 2x · 3x² = 6x³.” What has been violated?
exakt.Die Kettenregel, richtig wäre 5x⁴: The chain rule, correct would be 5x⁴
exakt.Die Produktregel, richtig wäre 5x⁴: The product rule, correct would be 5x⁴
exakt.Die Potenzregel, richtig wäre 6x³: The power rule, correct would be 6x³
exakt.Produkte werden nicht gliedweise abgelei: Products are not differentiated term by term. Easiest here: first combine to x⁵, then differentiate to 5x⁴. Using the product rule: 2x·x³ + x²·3x² = 2x⁴ + 3x⁴ = 5x⁴.
exakt.3.6 — Gib eine Funktion an, deren Ableit: 3.6 — Give a function whose derivative is f′(x) = 6x − 4. How many such functions are there?
exakt.Unendlich viele: 3x² − 4x + c für jedes: Infinitely many: 3x² − 4x + c for every c
exakt.Jede additive Konstante verschwindet bei: Every additive constant vanishes when differentiating. That's why there are infinitely many antiderivatives that differ only by c — a first glimpse of integral calculus.
exakt.3.7 — An welcher Stelle hat f(x) = ⅓x³ −: 3.7 — At which point does f(x) = ⅓x³ − x² have slope 3?
exakt.f′(x) = x² − 2x = 3 ⇒ x² − 2x − 3 = 0 ⇒: f′(x) = x² − 2x = 3 ⇒ x² − 2x − 3 = 0 ⇒ (x − 3)(x + 1) = 0. Important: bring the equation to zero instead of just leaving the 3 where it is.

exakt.Definitionsbereich, Nullstellen, Symmetr: Domain, zeros, symmetry and end behavior already determine the rough shape of the graph.

exakt.pq- oder abc-Formel bei quadratischen Gl: pq formula or quadratic formula for quadratic equations

exakt.Vielfachheit: einfach schneidet, doppelt: Multiplicity: a simple zero crosses, a double zero touches, a triple zero crosses with a horizontal tangent
exakt.4.1a — Bestimme alle Nullstellen von f(x: 4.1a — Find all zeros of f(x) = x³ − 4x.
exakt.x(x² − 4) = 0. Das Produkt ist null, wen: x(x² − 4) = 0. The product is zero if one factor is zero: x = 0 or x = ±2. If you divide by x instead of factoring out, you lose the zero at 0 — a classic.
exakt.Substitution z = x²: z² − 13z + 36 = 0 ⇒: Substitution z = x²: z² − 13z + 36 = 0 ⇒ z = 4 or z = 9. Back-substitution: x = ±2 and x = ±3. The most common mistake is stopping at z.
exakt.4.3 — f(x) = x³ − 2x² − 5x + 6 hat die N: 4.3 — f(x) = x³ − 2x² − 5x + 6 has the zero x₁ = 1. What are the others?
exakt.Division durch (x − 1) ergibt x² − x − 6: Dividing by (x − 1) gives x² − x − 6 = (x − 3)(x + 2). You find the guessed zero among the divisors of the constant term 6.
exakt.4.4c — Welche Symmetrie besitzt f(x) = x: 4.4c — What symmetry does f(x) = x³ + x² have?
exakt.f(−x) = −x³ + x² ist weder f(x) noch −f(: f(−x) = −x³ + x² is neither f(x) nor −f(x). Pure symmetry requires exclusively even or exclusively odd exponents. Mixed means: none.
exakt.4.5a — Beschreibe das Verhalten von f(x): 4.5a — Describe the behavior of f(x) = −2x³ + 5x² as x → ±∞.
Only the highest degree decides: −2x³. Odd degree with a negative leading coefficient means from top left to bottom right. The term 5x² plays no role at infinity.
exakt.4.6 — Bestimme Definitionsbereich und Nu: 4.6 — Find the domain and zero of f(x) = (x + 2)/(x² − 9).
exakt.Der Nenner wird bei x = ±3 null, dort li: The denominator becomes zero at x = ±3; those are poles. A fraction is zero when its numerator is zero: x = −2. Zeros of the denominator are never zeros of the function.
exakt.4.7 — Wie sieht der Graph von f(x) = (x: 4.7 — What does the graph of f(x) = (x − 2)²(x + 1) look like near x = 2?
exakt.Er berührt die x-Achse, dort liegt ein E: It touches the x-axis; there is an extreme point there
exakt.Er schneidet mit waagerechter Tangente: It crosses with a horizontal tangent
exakt.Die doppelte Nullstelle bedeutet Berühru: The double zero means touching. You can read this off the multiplicity without any derivative — and it saves real time in the exam.
exakt.f′ beschreibt, wohin der Graph läuft. Ex: f′ describes where the graph is heading. Extreme points of f are zeros of f′.
exakt.Die entscheidende Unterscheidung dieses: The key distinction in this building block is the one between a necessary and a sufficient condition.
exakt.f′(x) > 0 ⇒ streng monoton steigend, f′(: f′(x) > 0 ⇒ strictly increasing, f′(x) < 0 ⇒ strictly decreasing
exakt.Hinreichend: zusätzlich f″(x₀) ≠ 0. Nega: Sufficient: additionally f″(x₀) ≠ 0. Negative ⇒ maximum point, positive ⇒ minimum point
exakt.f″(x₀) = 0 ⇒ keine Aussage, jetzt zwinge: f″(x₀) = 0 ⇒ no conclusion; now you must check the sign change of f′
exakt.Auf [a; b] zusätzlich f(a) und f(b) verg: On [a; b], also compare f(a) and f(b) — boundary extrema are often forgotten in the Abitur
exakt.5.1 — Bestimme die Extrempunkte von f(x): 5.1 — Find the extreme points of f(x) = x³ − 3x.
exakt.f′ = 3x² − 3 = 0 ⇒ x = ±1. f″ = 6x: f″(−: f′ = 3x² − 3 = 0 ⇒ x = ±1. f″ = 6x: f″(−1) = −6 < 0 ⇒ maximum point, f″(1) = 6 > 0 ⇒ minimum point. Get the y-values by substituting into f, not into f′.
exakt.Warum reicht f′(x₀) = 0 allein nicht aus: Why is f′(x₀) = 0 alone not enough to prove an extreme point?
exakt.Weil die Rechnung ungenau sein könnte: Because the calculation might be inaccurate
exakt.Weil auch Sattelpunkte diese Bedingung e: Because saddle points also satisfy this condition
exakt.Weil x₀ außerhalb des Definitionsbereich: Because x₀ might lie outside the domain
exakt.f(x) = x³ hat bei 0 eine waagerechte Tan: f(x) = x³ has a horizontal tangent at 0, but no extreme point. The condition is necessary, not sufficient — hence the second check via f″ or the sign change.
exakt.5.2 — Untersuche f(x) = ¼x⁴ − 2x² auf Ex: 5.2 — Examine f(x) = ¼x⁴ − 2x² for extreme points.
exakt.f′ = x³ − 4x = x(x² − 4) ⇒ x = 0; ±2. f″: f′ = x³ − 4x = x(x² − 4) ⇒ x = 0; ±2. f″ = 3x² − 4: f″(0) = −4 < 0 ⇒ maximum point, f″(±2) = 8 > 0 ⇒ minimum points. The symmetry about the y-axis makes the two minimum points expected.
exakt.5.4 — Warum hat f(x) = x⁴ bei x = 0 eine: 5.4 — Why does f(x) = x⁴ have a minimum point at x = 0 even though f″(0) = 0?
exakt.Weil f′ dort von negativ nach positiv we: Because f′ changes from negative to positive there
exakt.Es ist gar kein Tiefpunkt, sondern ein S: It isn't a minimum point at all, but a saddle point
exakt.f″(0) = 0 liefert keine Aussage, das ist: f″(0) = 0 yields no conclusion; it doesn't rule anything out. Now the sign-change criterion applies: f′ = 4x³ is negative left of 0 and positive right of it — from decreasing to increasing, so a minimum point.
exakt.5.5 — Bestimme das globale Maximum von f: 5.5 — Find the global maximum of f(x) = x³ − 3x on the interval [0; 4].
exakt.Der Hochpunkt bei x = −1 liegt außerhalb: The maximum point at x = −1 lies outside the interval. Inside there is only the minimum point at x = 1. The maximum therefore lies at the boundary: f(4) = 64 − 12 = 52. Exactly this boundary comparison is the one most often forgotten in the Abitur.
f″ describes how the graph turns. Inflection points of f are extreme points of f′.
exakt.f″(x) > 0 ⇒ linksgekrümmt (konvex), f″(x: f″(x) > 0 ⇒ concave up (convex), f″(x) < 0 ⇒ concave down (concave)
exakt.Wendepunkt: f″(x₀) = 0 notwendig, f‴(x₀): Inflection point: f″(x₀) = 0 necessary, f‴(x₀) ≠ 0 sufficient
exakt.y-Wert immer über f(x₀) berechnen, dann: Always calculate the y-value via f(x₀), then write it as a point
exakt.Wendetangente: y = f′(x₀)(x − x₀) + f(x₀: Tangent at the inflection point: y = f′(x₀)(x − x₀) + f(x₀)
exakt.Sattelpunkt = Wendepunkt mit f′(x₀) = 0,: Saddle point = inflection point with f′(x₀) = 0, i.e. with a horizontal tangent
exakt.6.1 — Bestimme den Wendepunkt von f(x) =: 6.1 — Find the inflection point of f(x) = x³ − 3x².
exakt.f″ = 6x − 6 = 0 ⇒ x = 1. f‴ = 6 ≠ 0, als: f″ = 6x − 6 = 0 ⇒ x = 1. f‴ = 6 ≠ 0, so confirmed. y-value via f: f(1) = 1 − 3 = −2. The y-value must come from f, not from f″.
exakt.6.1 — Wie ist f(x) = x³ − 3x² links von: 6.1 — How is f(x) = x³ − 3x² curved to the left of x = 1?
exakt.Für x < 1 ist f″ = 6x − 6 < 0, also rech: For x < 1, f″ = 6x − 6 < 0, so the graph is concave down. To the right of the inflection point this reverses — exactly what makes this point an inflection point.
exakt.6.3 — Warum besitzt f(x) = x³ im Ursprun: 6.3 — Why does f(x) = x³ have a saddle point at the origin?
exakt.Weil f′(0) = 0 und f″(0) = 0 sind, aber: Because f′(0) = 0 and f″(0) = 0, but f‴(0) ≠ 0
exakt.Weil f″ dort das Vorzeichen nicht wechse: Because f″ doesn't change sign there
exakt.f′ = 3x², f″ = 6x, f‴ = 6. Bei x = 0 ver: f′ = 3x², f″ = 6x, f‴ = 6. At x = 0 the first and second derivatives vanish, the third doesn't. So an inflection point with a horizontal tangent — the definition of a saddle point.
exakt.6.4 — Der Graph von f′ ist eine nach obe: 6.4 — The graph of f′ is an upward-opening parabola with zeros at −2 and 4. What follows for f?
exakt.Hochpunkt bei −2, Tiefpunkt bei 4, Wende: Maximum point at −2, minimum point at 4, inflection point at 1
exakt.Tiefpunkt bei −2, Hochpunkt bei 4, Wende: Minimum point at −2, maximum point at 4, inflection point at 1
exakt.Hochpunkt bei 1, keine Wendestelle: Maximum point at 1, no inflection point
exakt.Nullstellen von f′ sind Extremstellen vo: Zeros of f′ are extreme points of f. Left of −2, f′ is positive (increasing), in between negative (decreasing), afterwards positive again: maximum, then minimum. The vertex of the parabola at x = 1 is the minimum of f′, and therefore the inflection point of f.
exakt.Hier wird nichts Neues gelernt. Es geht: Nothing new is learned here. It's solely about connecting all the sub-steps in a fixed order and writing them down cleanly.
exakt.Der Graph entsteht aus den berechneten P: The graph emerges from the calculated points — not the other way around.

exakt.8.1 — Bestimme die Tangente an f(x) = x²: 8.1 — Find the tangent to f(x) = x² − 2x + 3 at x₀ = 2.
exakt.f′(x) = 2x − 2, also f′(2) = 2. f(2) = 3: f′(x) = 2x − 2, so f′(2) = 2. f(2) = 3. Substitute: y = 2(x − 2) + 3 = 2x − 1. The answer y = −0.5x + 4 would be the normal.
exakt.8.2 — An welcher Stelle hat der Graph vo: 8.2 — At which point does the graph of f(x) = x³ − 3x² have a tangent with slope 9?
exakt.f′ = 3x² − 6x = 9 ⇒ 3x² − 6x − 9 = 0 ⇒ x: f′ = 3x² − 6x = 9 ⇒ 3x² − 6x − 9 = 0 ⇒ x² − 2x − 3 = 0 ⇒ x = 3 or x = −1. There is often more than one solution — stopping after the first one costs marks.
exakt.8.4 — Aus einem Karton 30 cm × 30 cm wer: 8.4 — From a 30 cm × 30 cm piece of cardboard, squares of side length x are cut from the corners and an open box is folded. For which x is the volume maximal?
exakt.V(x) = x(30 − 2x)². Ableiten und ausklam: V(x) = x(30 − 2x)². Differentiate and factor: V′ = (30 − 2x)(30 − 6x) ⇒ x = 5 or x = 15. At x = 15 the volume is zero, so it's a boundary case. That leaves x = 5 with V = 5 · 20² = 2000 cm³.
exakt.8.3 — Einem Parabelbogen y = 9 − x² wird: 8.3 — An axis-symmetric rectangle is inscribed above the x-axis under the parabolic arc y = 9 − x². What is the maximum area?
exakt.Breite 2x, Höhe 9 − x², also A(x) = 18x: Width 2x, height 9 − x², so A(x) = 18x − 2x³. A′ = 18 − 6x² = 0 ⇒ x = √3. Substitute: A = 2√3 · 6 = 12√3. The key is to set the width as 2x — the symmetry is easily overlooked.
exakt.8.5 — Eine ganzrationale Funktion dritte: 8.5 — A polynomial function of degree three is point-symmetric about the origin and has a maximum point at H(−1 | 2). What is f(x)?
exakt.Punktsymmetrie erlaubt nur ungerade Expo: Point symmetry allows only odd exponents: f = ax³ + bx. From f′(−1) = 0 it follows that 3a + b = 0, from f(−1) = 2 it follows that −a − b = 2. Substituting gives a = 1, b = −3.
exakt.8.7 — Für die Schar ft(x) = x³ − 3t²x mi: 8.7 — For the family ft(x) = x³ − 3t²x with t > 0: what is the locus of all maximum points?
exakt.f′ = 3x² − 3t² = 0 ⇒ x = ±t. Der Hochpun: f′ = 3x² − 3t² = 0 ⇒ x = ±t. The maximum point is at H(−t | 2t³). Now eliminate t: from x = −t it follows that t = −x, substituted y = 2(−x)³ = −2x³. The locus must no longer contain t.
exakt.8.8 — Untersuche f(x) = x · e⁻ˣ. Wo lieg: 8.8 — Examine f(x) = x · e⁻ˣ. Where is the maximum point?
exakt.Produktregel: f′ = e⁻ˣ − x·e⁻ˣ = e⁻ˣ(1 −: Product rule: f′ = e⁻ˣ − x·e⁻ˣ = e⁻ˣ(1 − x). e-terms are never zero, so the factor in front decides: 1 − x = 0 ⇒ x = 1. Correspondingly, the inflection point is at W(2 | 2e⁻²).

Pen & Paper tackles exactly that – not with more exercises, but with better thinking on paper.

exakt.Sieben Lektionen, ein System: Wie du so: Seven lessons, one system: how to write things down so your sheet takes load off your thinking instead of adding to it – from the two basic laws through the 7 Golden Rules to the Pen & Paper check before every submission. Watch the lessons in this order and grab a sheet of paper after each one.
exakt.Das Blatt ist nicht der Ort, an dem am E: The sheet isn't the place where the result ends up – it's your external working memory. If you keep everything in your head, there's no room left to think. Two laws carry the whole system: your sheet must take load off your thinking, not add to it. And every relevant step must be reconstructable for your future self.

exakt.Gesetz 2: Jeder relevante Schritt ist fü: Law 2: Every relevant step can be reconstructed by your future self

exakt.Das Ziel ist nicht, weniger denken zu mü: The goal isn't to have to think less. The goal is to be able to think better.
exakt.Woran erkennst du, dass eine Lösung Gese: How can you tell that a solution satisfies Law 2?

exakt.Die Lösung passt auf eine halbe Seite: The solution fits on half a page
exakt.Rekonstruierbarkeit heißt: Dein späteres: Reconstructable means: your future self – or your teacher – can follow every key step without you standing next to it explaining. A correct result alone doesn't show that.
exakt.Sieben Regeln machen aus einem Zettelcha: Seven rules turn a messy scrap of paper into readable working. They sound trivial – and that's exactly why they get broken all the time in exams. You'll learn what each rule means concretely on paper: one mathematical idea per line, lines below each other instead of side by side, white space as a tool.

exakt.In f(x) = mx + b steht die Steigung vor: In f(x) = mx + b the slope is in front of the x, the intercept is the number without x: m = −2, b = 5.
exakt.Die Steigung ist ein Verhältnis: Höhenun: The slope is a ratio: rise over run. With two points P(x₁ | y₁) and Q(x₂ | y₂) you calculate it using the difference quotient – the same idea the derivative later grows out of.
exakt.Das Steigungsdreieck darf beliebig groß: The slope triangle can be any size, the ratio stays the same
exakt.Reihenfolge der Punkte egal – aber oben: The order of the points doesn't matter – but it must be the same on top and bottom
exakt.Wie groß ist die Steigung der Geraden du: What is the slope of the line through P(1 | 2) and Q(4 | 11)?
exakt.Geradengleichung aus zwei Punkten: Equation of a line from two points
exakt.Aus zwei Punkten wird eine Gleichung: er: Two points become an equation: first m via the difference quotient, then substitute a point into y = mx + b and solve for b. Two steps, the same every time.
exakt.Schritt 2: Punkt einsetzen, nach b auflö: Step 2: substitute a point, solve for b
exakt.Probe mit dem zweiten Punkt – kostet zeh: Check with the second point – takes ten seconds
exakt.Erst m, dann b – und am Ende die Probe m: First m, then b – and at the end, check with the other point.

exakt.Wo sich zwei Geraden schneiden, haben si: Where two lines intersect, they have the same x-value and the same y-value. So you set the function terms equal, solve for x and substitute x into one of the equations.
exakt.Gleiche Steigung, verschiedenes b: paral: Same slope, different b: parallel, no intersection
exakt.Schnittpunkt heißt: gleichsetzen, x find: Intersection means: set equal, find x, calculate y.
exakt.Wo schneiden sich f(x) = 2x − 1 und g(x): Where do f(x) = 2x − 1 and g(x) = −x + 5 intersect?
exakt.Parallele Geraden haben dieselbe Steigun: Parallel lines have the same slope. You can recognize perpendicular (orthogonal) lines by the fact that the product of their slopes is −1 – one slope is the negative reciprocal of the other.
exakt.Senkrechte durch einen Punkt: Steigung b: Perpendicular through a point: determine the slope, substitute the point
exakt.Senkrecht heißt: Kehrwert nehmen und das: Perpendicular means: take the reciprocal and flip the sign.
exakt.Welche Steigung hat eine Gerade, die sen: What is the slope of a line perpendicular to y = 4x − 3?
exakt.Fünf Lektionen zu ganzrationalen Funktio: Five lessons on polynomial functions: degree and leading coefficient, end behavior, symmetry, zeros and polynomial division. Afterwards you'll read the graph off a function term before you calculate.
exakt.Eine ganzrationale Funktion ist eine Sum: A polynomial function is a sum of powers of x with numbers in front. The highest power is the degree, the number in front of it the leading coefficient – together they determine the basic shape of the graph.
exakt.f(x) = aₙxⁿ + … + a₁x + a₀ mit aₙ ≠ 0: f(x) = aₙxⁿ + … + a₁x + a₀ with aₙ ≠ 0
exakt.Grad n: höchste vorkommende Potenz: Degree n: highest power that occurs
exakt.Höchstens n Nullstellen und höchstens n: At most n zeros and at most n − 1 extreme points
exakt.Grad und Leitkoeffizient verraten die Gr: Degree and leading coefficient reveal the basic shape – the rest shapes the details.
exakt.Welchen Grad und welchen Leitkoeffizient: What are the degree and the leading coefficient of f(x) = 3x² − 2x⁴ + x − 7?
exakt.Die höchste Potenz ist x⁴ mit dem Faktor: The highest power is x⁴ with the factor −2. The order of the terms doesn't matter.
exakt.Für sehr große |x| dominiert der Summand: For very large |x| the term with the highest power dominates. That's why the degree (even or odd) and the sign of the leading coefficient are enough to say where the graph goes on the left and right.
exakt.Gerader Grad: beide Enden in dieselbe Ri: Even degree: both ends go in the same direction
exakt.Ungerader Grad: die Enden in entgegenges: Odd degree: the ends go in opposite directions
exakt.Leitkoeffizient > 0: rechts nach +∞: Leading coefficient > 0: to the right toward +∞
exakt.Im Unendlichen zählt nur der Summand mit: At infinity, only the term with the highest power counts.
exakt.Wie verläuft f(x) = −x³ + 5x für x → +∞?: How does f(x) = −x³ + 5x behave for x → +∞?
exakt.Der höchste Summand ist −x³. Für große p: The highest term is −x³. For large positive x, x³ is huge; with the minus sign in front, f(x) → −∞.
exakt.Kommen nur gerade Exponenten vor, ist de: If only even exponents occur, the graph is symmetric about the y-axis. If only odd ones occur, it is point-symmetric about the origin. Mixed: neither of these symmetries.
exakt.Nur gerade Exponenten (auch x⁰): f(−x) =: Only even exponents (including x⁰): f(−x) = f(x), symmetric about the y-axis
exakt.Formal immer mit f(−x) nachweisen: Formally, always prove it with f(−x)
exakt.Gerade Exponenten – Spiegel an der y-Ach: Even exponents – reflection in the y-axis. Odd – rotation about the origin.
exakt.Welche Symmetrie hat f(x) = x⁴ − 3x² + 2: What symmetry does f(x) = x⁴ − 3x² + 2 have?
exakt.Alle Exponenten sind gerade (4, 2 und 0: All exponents are even (4, 2 and 0 for the constant). So f(−x) = f(x).
exakt.Welche Technik passt, erkennst du am Ter: The term tells you which technique fits: no constant term – factor out x. Quadratic – pq or quadratic formula. Only x⁴ and x² – substitution. And if none of these works, a guessed zero with polynomial division helps.
exakt.Substitution z = x² bei biquadratischen: Substitution z = x² for biquadratic equations
exakt.Erst den Term anschauen, dann die Techni: Look at the term first, then choose the technique – not the other way round.
exakt.Welche Technik ist für x⁴ − 5x² + 4 = 0: Which technique is smartest for x⁴ − 5x² + 4 = 0?
exakt.Es kommen nur x⁴ und x² vor. Mit z = x²: Only x⁴ and x² occur. With z = x² this becomes z² − 5z + 4 = 0 with z = 1 and z = 4, so x = ±1 and x = ±2.
exakt.Kennst du eine Nullstelle x₀ – meist dur: If you know a zero x₀ – usually by guessing among the divisors of the constant term – you can split off the linear factor (x − x₀). What's left is a polynomial one degree lower, which you solve with the familiar techniques.
exakt.Nullstelle raten: Teiler des Absolutglie: Guess a zero: test divisors of the constant term
exakt.Eine Nullstelle raten, abspalten, den Re: Guess a zero, split it off, solve the rest with the pq formula.
exakt.f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 hat die Nullst: f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 11x − 6 has the zero x = 1. What is f(x) : (x − 1)?
exakt.Die Division ergibt x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2: The division gives x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3). So f has the zeros 1, 2 and 3.
exakt.Fünf Funktionsklassen, an denen im Abitu: Five classes of functions that carry a lot of points in the Abitur: the exponential function, the natural logarithm, sine and cosine, root functions and rational functions – each with graph, domain and typical properties.
exakt.Die natürliche Exponentialfunktion f(x): The natural exponential function f(x) = eˣ is the only function that is its own derivative. It is always positive, strictly increasing and approaches the x-axis as x → −∞.
exakt.eˣ ist nie null – eine Gleichung eˣ = 0: eˣ is never zero – an equation eˣ = 0 has no solution.
exakt.Wie viele Nullstellen hat f(x) = eˣ?: How many zeros does f(x) = eˣ have?
exakt.eˣ ist für jedes x positiv, erreicht die: eˣ is positive for every x, so it never reaches 0. At x = 0, f(0) = 1 – that's the y-intercept, not a zero.
exakt.ln ist die Umkehrfunktion von eˣ: ln(x): ln is the inverse function of eˣ: ln(x) answers the question “e to the power of what gives x?”. That's why ln is only defined for positive x, has the zero x = 1 and solves equations like eˣ = 5.
exakt.ln(eˣ) = x und e^(ln x) = x: ln(eˣ) = x and e^(ln x) = x
ln undoes eˣ – and vice versa.
exakt.Auf beiden Seiten ln anwenden: ln(eˣ) =: Apply ln to both sides: ln(eˣ) = ln(5), so x = ln(5) ≈ 1.609.
exakt.f(x) = a · sin(b(x − c)) + d: a streckt: f(x) = a · sin(b(x − c)) + d: a stretches in the y-direction (amplitude), b changes the period, c shifts to the right, d upward. This is how you model anything that repeats regularly.
exakt.c: Verschiebung in x-Richtung, d: Mittel: c: shift in the x-direction, d: midline y = d
exakt.a für die Höhe, b für die Breite, c und: a for the height, b for the width, c and d for shifting.
exakt.Welche Periode hat f(x) = 3 · sin(2x)?: What is the period of f(x) = 3 · sin(2x)?
exakt.p = 2π / b = 2π / 2 = π. Die 3 ist die A: p = 2π / b = 2π / 2 = π. The 3 is the amplitude and doesn't change the period.
exakt.Die Wurzelfunktion f(x) = √x ist die Umk: The square root function f(x) = √x is the inverse of x² for x ≥ 0. Its domain is restricted – nothing negative may be under the root – and its graph starts at the origin with a vertical tangent.
exakt.Verschiebungen wie bei Parabeln: √(x − c: Shifts work like with parabolas: √(x − c) + d
exakt.Bei jeder Wurzel zuerst fragen: Wo ist d: With every root, ask first: where is the radicand non-negative?
exakt.Welchen Definitionsbereich hat f(x) = √(: What is the domain of f(x) = √(3 − x)?
exakt.Ein Bruch aus zwei Polynomen. Wo der Nen: A fraction of two polynomials. Where the denominator becomes zero, the function is undefined – there you'll find a pole with a vertical asymptote or a removable discontinuity. Comparing the degrees of numerator and denominator gives the end behavior.
exakt.Definitionslücken: Nullstellen des Nenne: Points not in the domain: zeros of the denominator
exakt.Pol mit senkrechter Asymptote, wenn der: Pole with vertical asymptote if the numerator isn't also 0 there
exakt.Zählergrad < Nennergrad: waagerechte Asy: Numerator degree < denominator degree: horizontal asymptote y = 0
exakt.Erst den Nenner untersuchen – er entsche: Examine the denominator first – it decides about gaps and poles.
exakt.Welche senkrechte Asymptote hat f(x) = (: What vertical asymptote does f(x) = (x + 1) / (x − 2) have?
exakt.Der Nenner wird bei x = 2 null, der Zähl: The denominator becomes zero at x = 2, the numerator doesn't (3 ≠ 0). So a pole with vertical asymptote x = 2. y = 1 is the horizontal asymptote.
exakt.Fünf Lektionen, eine Kette: vom Differen: Five lessons, one chain: from the difference quotient through the differentiation rules to full curve sketching. Each lesson builds on the previous one – watch them in this order.
exakt.Vom Differenzenquotienten zur Ableitung: From the difference quotient to the derivative
exakt.Die Ableitung ist keine Formel, sondern: The derivative isn't a formula, it's a slope: the slope of the tangent at a point. You'll see how the secant slope turns into the instantaneous rate of change through the limit h → 0.
exakt.Differenzenquotient = Sekantensteigung =: Difference quotient = secant slope = average rate of change
exakt.Differentialquotient = Tangentensteigung: Differential quotient = tangent slope = instantaneous rate of change
exakt.Erst h kürzen, dann h gegen 0 laufen las: First cancel h, then let h go to 0 – never the other way round.
exakt.Was beschreibt der Differenzenquotient [: What does the difference quotient [f(x₀ + h) − f(x₀)] / h describe for h ≠ 0?
exakt.Die Steigung der Tangente in x₀: The slope of the tangent at x₀
exakt.Die Steigung der Sekante durch zwei Kurv: The slope of the secant through two points on the curve
exakt.Den Funktionswert an der Stelle x₀ + h: The function value at x₀ + h
exakt.Solange h ≠ 0 ist, verbindet man zwei Pu: As long as h ≠ 0, you're connecting two points on the graph – that's a secant. Only in the limit h → 0 does it become the tangent.
exakt.Niemand rechnet jede Ableitung mit der h: Nobody calculates every derivative with the h-method. The power, constant multiple, sum, product, quotient and chain rules are the tools you use to differentiate every function in the upper school.
exakt.Produktregel: (u · v)′ = u′ · v + u · v′: Product rule: (u · v)′ = u′ · v + u · v′
exakt.Kettenregel: äußere Ableitung mal innere: Chain rule: outer derivative times inner derivative
exakt.Erst die Struktur erkennen – Summe, Prod: First recognize the structure – sum, product, quotient or composition – then choose the rule.
exakt.Was ist die Ableitung von f(x) = (3x + 1: What is the derivative of f(x) = (3x + 1)⁴?
exakt.Kettenregel: äußere Ableitung 4 · (3x +: Chain rule: outer derivative 4 · (3x + 1)³ times inner derivative 3 gives 12 · (3x + 1)³.
exakt.Hoch- und Tiefpunkte liegen dort, wo der: Maximum and minimum points are where the graph is horizontal. The necessary condition f′(x) = 0 gives candidates; the sufficient condition decides whether there really is an extremum – and which kind.
exakt.f″(x₀) < 0 → Hochpunkt, f″(x₀) > 0 → Tie: f″(x₀) < 0 → maximum point, f″(x₀) > 0 → minimum point
exakt.Ist f″(x₀) = 0, sagt die zweite Ableitun: If f″(x₀) = 0, the second derivative tells you nothing – then the sign change of f′ decides.
exakt.Es gilt f′(2) = 0 und f″(2) = −3. Was li: We have f′(2) = 0 and f″(2) = −3. What is at x = 2?
exakt.Die Steigung ist null und die Krümmung n: The slope is zero and the curvature is negative (concave down) – the graph peaks here: maximum point.
exakt.Am Wendepunkt wechselt der Graph seine K: At an inflection point the graph changes its concavity – from concave up to concave down or vice versa. That's exactly where the slope is locally greatest or smallest.
exakt.Hinreichend: zusätzlich f‴(x₀) ≠ 0 oder: Sufficient: additionally f‴(x₀) ≠ 0 or a sign change of f″
exakt.Den y-Wert immer in f einsetzen – nicht: Always substitute into f for the y-value – not into f′ or f″
exakt.Wendestellen von f sind Extremstellen vo: Inflection points of f are extreme points of f′.
exakt.Bei welcher Funktion liegt an der Stelle: For which function is there an inflection point at x = 0?
exakt.Bei x³ ist f″(x) = 6x – Vorzeichenwechse: For x³, f″(x) = 6x – sign change at 0, so inflection point. For x⁴, f″(0) = 0 too, but f″(x) = 12x² doesn't change sign.
exakt.Jetzt fügst du alles zusammen: Definitio: Now you put everything together: domain, symmetry, end behavior, zeros, extreme and inflection points – in a fixed order, neatly written down.
exakt.Eine feste Reihenfolge spart Zeit und ve: A fixed order saves time and prevents gaps
exakt.Symmetrie und Grenzverhalten zuerst – si: Symmetry and end behavior first – they give you the rough sketch
exakt.Am Ende alle Punkte in eine Skizze eintr: At the end, plot all points in a sketch and check for plausibility
exakt.Passt ein berechneter Punkt nicht zur Sk: If a calculated point doesn't fit the sketch, the mistake is in the calculation – not in the sketch.
exakt.f(x) = x³ − 3x. Welche Symmetrie hat der: f(x) = x³ − 3x. What symmetry does the graph have?
exakt.Es kommen nur ungerade Exponenten vor (3: Only odd exponents occur (3 and 1). So f(−x) = −f(x): point-symmetric about the origin.
exakt.Fünf Lektionen, eine Umkehrung: Aus der: Five lessons, one reversal: the derivative leads to the antiderivative, the antiderivative to the integral – and with it areas, areas between graphs and volumes of revolution.
exakt.Eine Stammfunktion F ist eine Funktion,: An antiderivative F is a function whose derivative is f. You find it by applying the differentiation rules in reverse – for powers: raise the exponent by 1 and divide by the new exponent.
exakt.Jede Stammfunktion + C ist wieder eine S: Any antiderivative + C is again an antiderivative
exakt.Probe durch Ableiten: F′ muss wieder f e: Check by differentiating: F′ must give f again.
exakt.Welche Funktion ist eine Stammfunktion v: Which function is an antiderivative of f(x) = 3x²?
exakt.x² → x³/3, mal 3 ergibt x³. Probe: (x³)′: x² → x³/3, times 3 gives x³. Check: (x³)′ = 3x² ✓.
exakt.Der Hauptsatz der Differential- und Inte: The fundamental theorem of calculus connects the two: the definite integral from a to b is the difference of the antiderivative values, ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a). That turns an area into a simple calculation.
exakt.Die Konstante C fällt bei der Differenz: The constant C cancels out in the difference
exakt.Sauber notieren: erst die eckige Klammer: Write it neatly: first the square brackets, then substitute
exakt.Stammfunktion bilden, obere Grenze minus: Find the antiderivative, upper limit minus lower limit.
exakt.Das Integral zählt Flächen unter der x-A: The integral counts areas below the x-axis as negative – it's a net area. If you want the actual area, split at the zeros and add the absolute values of the partial integrals.
exakt.Zuerst die Nullstellen im Intervall best: First determine the zeros in the interval
exakt.Einzelintegrale zwischen den Nullstellen: Calculate the individual integrals between the zeros
exakt.Fläche = Summe der Beträge: Area = sum of the absolute values
exakt.Integral ist Bilanz, Fläche ist Betrag –: Integral is net balance, area is absolute value – split at the zeros.
exakt.∫₋₁¹ x³ dx = 0. Wie groß ist die Fläche: ∫₋₁¹ x³ dx = 0. What is the area between the graph and the x-axis from −1 to 1?
exakt.Zerlegen bei 0: |∫₋₁⁰ x³ dx| + |∫₀¹ x³ d: Split at 0: |∫₋₁⁰ x³ dx| + |∫₀¹ x³ dx| = 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2.
exakt.Die Fläche zwischen f und g berechnest d: You calculate the area between f and g via the difference function d(x) = f(x) − g(x). The intersection points of f and g are the zeros of d – and thus the limits.
exakt.A = |∫ (f(x) − g(x)) dx| zwischen benach: A = |∫ (f(x) − g(x)) dx| between neighboring intersections
exakt.Bei mehreren Schnittstellen: Teilflächen: With several intersections: partial areas separately, add the absolute values
exakt.Erst die Differenzfunktion, dann wie bei: First the difference function, then just like the area with the x-axis.
exakt.Welche Grenzen hat die Fläche zwischen f: What are the limits of the area between f(x) = x² and g(x) = x?
exakt.Dreht sich der Graph von f um die x-Achs: If the graph of f rotates about the x-axis, a solid is formed. Its volume is made up of infinitely thin circular discs with radius f(x): V = π · ∫ₐᵇ (f(x))² dx.
exakt.Erst quadrieren, dann integrieren – nich: Square first, then integrate – not the other way round
exakt.Kreisscheiben aufsummieren: π mal das In: Add up circular discs: π times the integral of f².
exakt.Welches Volumen hat der Körper, der ents: What is the volume of the solid formed when f(x) = √x on [0; 2] is rotated about the x-axis?
exakt.Vom einzelnen Vektor bis zur Ebene: In f: From a single vector to the plane: in five lessons you build the tools of analytic geometry – and a fixed procedure for every typical Abitur question.
exakt.Ein Vektor ist eine Verschiebung: Er hat: A vector is a displacement: it has a direction and a length, but no fixed location. You'll learn about position vectors, connecting vectors and the magnitude of a vector.
exakt.Verbindungsvektor: AB = B − A („Spitze m: Connecting vector: AB = B − A (“tip minus tail”)
exakt.Ortsvektor: der Vektor vom Ursprung zum: Position vector: the vector from the origin to the point
exakt.Punkte haben Koordinaten, Vektoren haben: Points have coordinates, vectors have direction and length – both are written similarly but mean different things.
exakt.A(1 | 2 | 0) und B(4 | 6 | 0). Wie lang: A(1 | 2 | 0) and B(4 | 6 | 0). How long is the vector AB?
exakt.Das Skalarprodukt verrechnet zwei Vektor: The dot product combines two vectors into a number. That number reveals the angle between them – and above all, whether they are perpendicular.
exakt.a · b = 0 ⇔ a und b sind orthogonal: a · b = 0 ⇔ a and b are orthogonal
exakt.Skalarprodukt null heißt rechter Winkel: Dot product zero means right angle – the fastest orthogonality test in upper-school math.
exakt.Eine Gerade im Raum braucht einen Startp: A line in space needs a starting point (position vector) and a direction (direction vector). Using the parameter t you can reach every point on the line.
exakt.g: x = p + t · u mit Stützvektor p und R: g: x = p + t · u with position vector p and direction vector u
exakt.Aus zwei Punkten A und B: Stützvektor A,: From two points A and B: position vector A, direction vector B − A
exakt.Punktprobe: Punkt einsetzen und prüfen,: Point test: substitute the point and check whether one t satisfies all three rows
exakt.Ein t für alle drei Koordinaten – liefer: One t for all three coordinates – if one row gives a different t, the point isn't on the line.
exakt.Nein, die t-Werte widersprechen sich: No, the t-values contradict each other
exakt.1 + 2t = 5 → t = 2; 0 + t = 2 → t = 2; 2: 1 + 2t = 5 → t = 2; 0 + t = 2 → t = 2; 2 − t = 0 → t = 2. All three rows give t = 2, so P lies on g.
exakt.Zwei Geraden im Raum sind identisch, ech: Two lines in space are identical, parallel (but distinct), intersecting or skew. A fixed checking scheme always leads to the right answer.
exakt.Schritt 1: Sind die Richtungsvektoren Vi: Step 1: Are the direction vectors multiples? → parallel or identical
exakt.Schritt 2: Sonst gleichsetzen: lösbar →: Step 2: Otherwise set equal: solvable → intersection point, unsolvable → skew
exakt.Windschief gibt es nur im Raum, nie in d: Skew lines only exist in space, never in the plane
exakt.Erst die Richtungsvektoren vergleichen,: Compare the direction vectors first, then set equal – this order saves work.
exakt.Die Richtungsvektoren sind keine Vielfac: The direction vectors are not multiples of each other, and the system of equations has no solution. How are the lines positioned?
exakt.Nicht parallel und trotzdem kein gemeins: Not parallel and yet no common point – that's exactly what skew means.
exakt.Eine Ebene lässt sich in Parameter-, Nor: A plane can be described in parametric, normal or coordinate form. Each form has its strengths – the Abitur requires you to switch confidently between them.
exakt.Parameterform: Stützvektor plus zwei Spa: Parametric form: position vector plus two spanning vectors
exakt.Normalenvektor über das Kreuzprodukt der: Normal vector via the cross product of the spanning vectors
exakt.Koordinatenform n₁x₁ + n₂x₂ + n₃x₃ = d –: Coordinate form n₁x₁ + n₂x₂ + n₃x₃ = d – ideal for point tests and intersections
exakt.Die Koeffizienten der Koordinatenform bi: The coefficients of the coordinate form directly give a normal vector.
exakt.E: 2x₁ − x₂ + 4x₃ = 7. Welcher Vektor is: E: 2x₁ − x₂ + 4x₃ = 7. Which vector is a normal vector of E?
exakt.Die Koeffizienten vor x₁, x₂, x₃ – also: The coefficients of x₁, x₂, x₃ – i.e. 2, −1 and 4 – form a normal vector.
exakt.Vom Baumdiagramm bis zum Hypothesentest:: From tree diagrams to hypothesis testing: five lessons that boil upper-school probability down to a few clear rules.
exakt.Mehrstufige Zufallsversuche werden mit d: Multi-stage random experiments become clear with a tree diagram. Two path rules are enough to read off any probability.
exakt.1. Pfadregel: Wahrscheinlichkeiten entla: 1st path rule: multiply probabilities along a path
exakt.2. Pfadregel: Wahrscheinlichkeiten passe: 2nd path rule: add the probabilities of matching paths
exakt.Die Äste an jedem Knoten ergeben zusamme: The branches at each node add up to 1
exakt.Eine Münze wird zweimal geworfen. Wie gr: A coin is tossed twice. What is P(exactly one head)?
exakt.Zwei passende Pfade (Kopf–Zahl und Zahl–: Two matching paths (head–tail and tail–head), each with 1/2 · 1/2 = 1/4. Together 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2.
exakt.Zwei Merkmale, vier Kombinationen: Die V: Two attributes, four combinations: the two-way table organizes them. With it you calculate conditional probabilities – that is: how likely is B if A is already given?
exakt.Zeilen- und Spaltensummen ergeben die Ra: Row and column totals give the marginal probabilities, everything together adds up to 1
exakt.A und B unabhängig ⇔ P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P: A and B independent ⇔ P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P(B)
exakt.Bei der bedingten Wahrscheinlichkeit rec: For conditional probability you only work within the row of the condition – it becomes the new whole.
exakt.P(A) = 0,4 und P(A ∩ B) = 0,1. Wie groß: P(A) = 0.4 and P(A ∩ B) = 0.1. What is P_A(B)?
